Kintetsu 02

Step-free guide

StationE01

ElevatorエレベーターStep-free transfers

Kintetsu publishes a no-steps route — lift, escalator or ramp, whichever fits the leg — from its platforms to the JR local lines, the Shinkansen, the Higashiyama and Sakura-dori subway lines and the Aonami Line. It is not the same single lift for every route: the Front Gate alone has separate step-free links to platform 1, platforms 2–3, and platforms 4–5.

AFront Gate → Platform 1
Escalator runs up only until 10:00 on weekdays.
BFront Gate → Platforms 2–3
Escalator runs down only from 18:30.
CFront Gate → Platforms 4–5
Lift, escalator and ramp.
The exception
The route to Meitetsu is published, but not marked step-free. Plan that leg separately.
Also here
A wheelchair you can borrow at the station.
Electric wheelchairs
Handle-type electric wheelchairs are accepted. Enter the lift facing forward, exit backward — and they cannot use the connecting gate through to Meitetsu.

Accessible toilet車椅子トイレOne toilet

One wheelchair-accessible toilet, with a baby changing shelf. The ostomate fitting is not only there: it is also in the underground women’s toilet.

AThe wheelchair-accessible toilet
Ostomate fitting and baby changing shelf.
BUnderground (B1F) women’s toilet
Also has an ostomate fitting — not wheelchair-accessible itself.
Exact position
Not published in text. Illustrated once we have walked it.
Also at the station
Braille fare table, braille information board, guidance chimes at the gates and on platform stairs, a hearing-assistance mark (耳マーク), an English-language ticket machine, and a fax line for booking assistance.

Entrances & exits出入口B1F, Hirokoji side

Kintetsu Nagoya is underground (B1F), west of Meitetsu and beside the Kintetsu Passe store, reached from the Hirokoji side.

Two gates
A Front Gate (正面改札口) and an Underground Gate (地下改札口) — both step-free from street level.
Direct connecting gates
A step-free connecting gate straight through to JR/Shinkansen, and another straight through to Meitetsu — you do not have to leave the building for either.
From the subway
Exit 9 serves the Kintetsu underground gate — by stairs.
Also here
Coin lockers, station office, ATM and a taxi rank.

Opening hours営業時間First to last train

Staff are on duty from the first train to the last.

Limited-express window
5:30–23:20.
Commuter pass machines
6:00–23:00.
